1. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and flange member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void, wherein the filler comprises __a formed composite material selected from the group consisting of unidirectional composite tape, composite laminate, hybrid tape-fabric member, and titanium__; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, wherein __the adhesive is a structural adhesive that is distinct from and does not include the laminated composite tape or the composite fabric layers__.

2. (Original)

4. (Original)

5. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric __are applied as distinct layers and__ extend beyond the radius areas.

6. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other __and are not formed as a continuous single layer across all three members__.

7. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone, wherein __the reinforcing member comprises a formed composite material selected from the group consisting of unidirectional composite tape, composite laminate, hybrid tape-fabric member, and titanium__; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, wherein __the adhesive is a structural adhesive that is distinct from and does not include the laminated composite tape or the composite fabric layers__.

12. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes __at least three separate composite patches respectively positioned on each of the channels and the base, with gaps between the patches__.

13. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler __and wherein the adhesive layer is applied separately from the formation of the composite channels and base__.

14. (Original)

15. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are __formed from multi-directional laminated composite tape plies and the base is formed from unidirectional laminated composite tape plies__.

25. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape having a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a cap and a base, with the cap including radius areas between the web and the flanges and the base including radius areas between the web and the flanges, the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas in the radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone, wherein __the reinforcing filler comprises a formed composite material selected from the group consisting of unidirectional composite tape, composite laminate, hybrid tape-fabric member, and titanium__; and a layer of structural adhesive surrounding and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, wherein __the adhesive is applied as a distinct layer separate from the laminated composite tape and composite fabric layers__.
